items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: I had worked with Oscar on Charlie Barnet’s band.

ctx.x: Well looking at this list of bands and I’m trying to think of someone you haven’t played with. Is there somebody that you wish you had played with?

Yeah, Duke. I had three chances to go with him. The first one was when Oscar Pettiford was in the band and I had worked with Oscar on Charlie Barnet’s band. He had two basses believe it or not, Chubby Jackson and Oscar. And that didn’t last too long because Chubby one day came to Oscar and said, “we’re going down front with our basses and we’re going to do a dance.” So Oscar says, “I’m a bass player, bye.” And he split.
I could see Chubby doing that but probably not Oscar.
